instructions_to_main_agent: Build a pure PWA (manifest.json + service worker) using React CRA and Tailwind.
Do NOT implement authentication or users. Implement a simple Admin mode protected by a PIN (default 1234) stored in localStorage.

Implement the ES-DE style launcher: Horizontal scrolling list of posters (aspect-[2/3]). The background of the entire app MUST dynamically change to a blurred and darkened version of the currently focused/hovered poster.

Implement 12 complete themes using CSS variables in index.css. Map Tailwind config colors to these variables (e.g. `bg-primary: 'var(--bg-primary)'`, `brand: 'var(--brand)'`). Apply the variables dynamically to a wrapper or the body.
Create a ThemeContext to switch between the 12 themes and persist choice in localStorage. Default theme is 'tengoku'. Apply specific fonts conditionally based on the active theme.
When a user clicks a poster, navigate to a Detail page. The detail page has a large 'LANCER' button.
When 'LANCER' is clicked, play a background ambient track (audio element) and perform the action (e.g. open a modal to read chapter 1).
Ensure keyboard navigation (arrow keys) works seamlessly between posters, as it's a launcher app.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never apply universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific properties.
Do not center align the app container in App.css.
Layer elements to create depth: Background image (z-0, blur-2xl) -> Scrim overlay (z-1, bg-black/60) -> Content (z-10).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons depending on the theme's --radius-base.
Ensure high contrast and readability over the dynamic blurred background.
